gold: Drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors (infliximab and adalimumab)

selector.rationale: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids and crusty plaques on the eyelid margins support blepharitis, with infliximab as a potential cause

rejected.label: Adalimumab-induced Ectropion
rejected.why: Ectropion occurred after switching to adalimumab, but the primary issue of blepharitis is more directly linked to infliximab

rejected.label: Ectropion
rejected.why: While ectropion is present, it is not the primary diagnosis that explains the bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous eyelids

rejected.label: Conjunctivitis
rejected.why: Diffuse conjunctival hyperemia is noted, but the primary findings support blepharitis over conjunctivitis

support_spans: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
